subject: Plot Builder Radio Button is missing

messages.author: 50e3751e828b3a28
messages.subject: Plot Builder Radio Button is missing
parts:
I am running R 3.0.2 on Ubuntu, Windows 7, and Windows 8. I recently updated Rattle to 3.0.2 r169 on all three platforms. On all three platforms when I open the Explore tab and click on the Interactive radio button I only see Latticist and GGobi radio buttons, but no PlotBuilder. I can get Plot Builder by loading Deducer, which loads without error.

Thank you,

Roy Robertson

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: Plot Builder Radio Button is missing
parts:
Hi Roy,

Yes, it had to be removed due to CRAN policy and a limitation of PlotBuilder - PlotBuilder seems to only be able to load data from the user's global environment and CRAN policy does not allow me to assign to variables (as I was) in the user's global environment, even when asking the user.

As you note, instead, you can start plot builder from the command line with something like:

Load data into Rattle as normal.

> library(Deducer)
> ds <- crs$dataset
> deducer(cmd="Plot builder")

Graham Williams
http://togaware.com
